label: VALIDATION_COUNTRY_NOTEMPTY
definition: A Validation Test, applied to a SingleRecord, that evaluates: Is there a value in dwc:country? It returns: COMPLIANT if dwc:country is bdqval:NotEmpty or dwc:countryCode has a value of "XZ" and either dwc:country is bdqval:Empty or has a value of "High seas"; otherwise NOT_COMPLIANT.
description: Is there a value in dwc:country?
notes: Country is expected to be either bdqval:Empty or, ideally, have a value of "High seas" or an agreed equivalent if material comes from the high seas, or from those portions of Antarctica outside of any sovereign nation.
expectedResponse: COMPLIANT if dwc:country is bdqval:NotEmpty or dwc:countryCode has a value of "XZ" and either dwc:country is bdqval:Empty or has a value of "High seas"; otherwise NOT_COMPLIANT
examples: [dwc:country="Eswatini": Response.status=RUN_HAS_RESULT, Response.result=COMPLIANT, Response.comment="dwc:country is bdqval:NotEmpty"],[dwc:country="": Response.status=RUN_HAS_RESULT, Response.result=NOT_COMPLIANT, Response.comment="dwc:country is bdqval:Empty"]
references: • Chapman AD and Wieczorek JR (2020) Georeferencing Best Practices. Copenhagen: GBIF Secretariat. https://doi.org/10.15468/doc-gg7h-s853
issueLabels: TG2 Validation SPACE CODED Test Completeness CORE

label: MULTIRECORD_MEASURE_QA_COUNTRY_NOTEMPTY
prefLabel: Measurement over MultiRecord for QualityAssurance of Validation dwc:country Not Empty
definition: A Measure, applied to a MultiRecord, that evaluates for quality assurance: Measure if all VALIDATION_COUNTRY_NOTEMPTY in a record set are COMPLIANT. It returns: COMPLETE if every VALIDATION_COUNTRY_NOTEMPTY in the MultiRecord has Response.result=COMPLIANT; otherwise NOT_COMPLETE. It is based on the aggregated outcomes of the Test(s): VALIDATION_COUNTRY_NOTEMPTY.
description: Measure if all VALIDATION_COUNTRY_NOTEMPTY in a record set are COMPLIANT.
notes: For Quality Assurance, filter record set until this measure is COMPLETE.
expectedResponse: COMPLETE if every VALIDATION_COUNTRY_NOTEMPTY in the MultiRecord has Response.result=COMPLIANT; otherwise NOT_COMPLETE.
references: Veiga AK, Saraiva AM, Chapman AD, Morris PJ, Gendreau C, Schigel D, Robertson TJ (2017). A conceptual framework for quality assessment and management of biodiversity data. PLOS ONE 12(6): e0178731. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0178731
issueLabels: TG2 Validation SPACE CODED Test Completeness CORE

label: MULTIRECORD_MEASURE_COUNT_COMPLIANT_COUNTRY_NOTEMPTY
prefLabel: Measurement over MultiRecord Counting Compliance of Validation dwc:country Not Empty
definition: A Measure, applied to a MultiRecord, that evaluates for quality control: Count the number of VALIDATION_COUNTRY_NOTEMPTY in a record set that are COMPLIANT. It returns: Count the number of VALIDATION_COUNTRY_NOTEMPTY in the MultiRecord that have Response.result=COMPLIANT. It is based on the aggregated outcomes of the Test(s): VALIDATION_COUNTRY_NOTEMPTY.
description: Count the number of VALIDATION_COUNTRY_NOTEMPTY in a record set that are COMPLIANT.
notes: For Quality Control, compare the Response.result of this measure with the total number of records to assess work needed on the record set.
expectedResponse: Count the number of VALIDATION_COUNTRY_NOTEMPTY in the MultiRecord that have Response.result=COMPLIANT.
references: Veiga AK, Saraiva AM, Chapman AD, Morris PJ, Gendreau C, Schigel D, Robertson TJ (2017). A conceptual framework for quality assessment and management of biodiversity data. PLOS ONE 12(6): e0178731. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0178731
